integrity: The infinite singular-value limit follows from an analytic finite-band counting proof; finite sections give corroboration only. Historical compactness and eigenvalue results are credited, not claimed as new. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The weight ratio is fixed strictly between zero and one; no uniform estimate as the ratio tends to one is claimed.
No explicit finite-index singular-value formulas or secondary asymptotic coefficient is established.
Equivalence to broader existing discrete pseudodifferential Weyl asymptotics remains a bibliographic risk.
title: A sharp singular-value Weyl law for the geometrically weighted Cesàro operator
